mission_02: Great work! You have successfully applied t-SNE to visualize high-dimensional data in 2D. You learned how t-SNE preserves local structure, making it ideal for revealing clusters and patterns that PCA might miss. Unlike PCA, t-SNE is non-linear and stochastic, so results may vary between runs. Set random_state for reproducibility. t-SNE is primarily a visualization tool, not a feature engineering method, because the embedding is specific to the dataset and does not generalize to new data. For production feature reduction, prefer PCA or UMAP.
